subject: Math
text_verbatim: Chapter 1 Numberland Adventures: Up to 999 Connect and Create Mystery Number Fun 1. Look at the boxes below, and read the clues. 2. Think about the clues with a classmate, and circle the correct number. 3. Did you find all the answers? Well done! Now have some fun, and colour each box to make a colourful pattern. 45 25 10 53 It is more than 20 It has 5 in the Ones place It is less than 30 82 50 23 45 It is more than 60 It has 2 in the Ones place 62 31 18 20 It is less than 24 It is 5 groups of 4 84 102 408 48 It is more than 50 It has 0 in it When you add 100 to it you get 202 452 952 421 654 It is greater than 450 It has 5 in the Tens place It is greater than 950 127 307 67 142 It has a 7 in the Ones place It is greater than 100 It has a 0 in the Tens place 795 895 995 305 It has 5 in the Ones place It is more than 500 It is 5 less than 1000 199 47 124 109 It is greater than 100 It is 1 less than 200 429 381 364 533 It has a 3 in it It is greater than 300 The numbers add up to 12 31

exercises.label: Mystery Number Fun - Box 1 (45, 25, 10, 53)
exercises.instruction_verbatim: It is more than 20 / It has 5 in the Ones place / It is less than 30
exercises.answer_key: 25 (more than 20 rules out 10; has 5 in Ones place narrows to 45 or 25; less than 30 rules out 45).

exercises.label: Mystery Number Fun - Box 2 (82, 50, 23, 45)
exercises.instruction_verbatim: It is more than 60 / It has 2 in the Ones place
exercises.answer_key: 82 (only candidate more than 60; also the only one ending in 2).

exercises.label: Mystery Number Fun - Box 3 (62, 31, 18, 20)
exercises.instruction_verbatim: It is less than 24 / It is 5 groups of 4
exercises.answer_key: 20 (less than 24 narrows to 18 or 20; 5 groups of 4 = 20).

exercises.label: Mystery Number Fun - Box 4 (84, 102, 408, 48)
exercises.instruction_verbatim: It is more than 50 / It has 0 in it / When you add 100 to it you get 202
exercises.answer_key: 102 (more than 50 rules out 48; has 0 in it narrows to 102 or 408; 102 + 100 = 202).

exercises.label: Mystery Number Fun - Box 5 (452, 952, 421, 654)
exercises.instruction_verbatim: It is greater than 450 / It has 5 in the Tens place / It is greater than 950
exercises.answer_key: 952 (greater than 450 rules out 421; has 5 in Tens place narrows to 452 or 952; greater than 950 selects 952).

exercises.label: Mystery Number Fun - Box 6 (127, 307, 67, 142)
exercises.instruction_verbatim: It has a 7 in the Ones place / It is greater than 100 / It has a 0 in the Tens place
exercises.answer_key: 307 (7 in Ones place narrows to 127, 307, or 67; greater than 100 rules out 67, leaving 127 or 307; 0 in Tens place selects 307).

exercises.label: Mystery Number Fun - Box 7 (795, 895, 995, 305)
exercises.instruction_verbatim: It has 5 in the Ones place / It is more than 500 / It is 5 less than 1000
exercises.answer_key: 995 (all four candidates have 5 in the Ones place, so this clue alone does not narrow; more than 500 rules out 305; 1000 - 5 = 995 selects the answer).

exercises.label: Mystery Number Fun - Box 8 (199, 47, 124, 109)
exercises.instruction_verbatim: It is greater than 100 / It is 1 less than 200
exercises.answer_key: 199 (greater than 100 rules out 47; 200 - 1 = 199 selects the answer over 124/109).

exercises.label: Mystery Number Fun - Box 9 (429, 381, 364, 533)
exercises.instruction_verbatim: It has a 3 in it / It is greater than 300 / The numbers add up to 12
exercises.answer_key: 381 (has a 3 in it rules out 429, leaving 381/364/533, all already greater than 300; digit sum: 3+8+1=12, 3+6+4=13, 5+3+3=11 - only 381 sums to 12).
